periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the sagittal plane of the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1:1.6.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering of the patch inferior to the ocular center point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, relatively flat U-shaped curve at the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Large-scale coverage, occupying approximately 45% of the visible vertical torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distance between ear regions is roughly equivalent to 1.2x the horizontal width of a single pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow discoloration present on the ventral and abdominal fur compared to the cranial white fur.
